name: add-volume-weighted-ma-indicator
rationale: SMA/EMA ignore volume entirely, so thin-volume price spikes can move the target allocation as much as high-conviction moves. A volume-weighted moving average (VWMA) as an additional IndicatorPoint field would let a future (human-reviewed) change to compute_btc_target discount low-volume moves.
code_change_summary: Add src/signal/indicators/vwma.rs implementing the Indicator trait (mirroring sma.rs), add a `vwma: Option<f64>` field to IndicatorPoint (src/signal/mod.rs) and populate it in compute_indicators() and SignalEngine::run()'s per-candle snapshot mapping. Do NOT wire it into TradingEngine::compute_btc_target's formula — this hypothesis only adds the raw value for a later human-reviewed change to consume.
constraints: MUST NOT modify the body of TradingEngine::compute_btc_target (sub-signal mappings or weighting formula) — see the 'DO NOT let automated tools rewrite' comment on that function. Signature-only changes to fix a compile error are allowed but must be called out explicitly in the PR description.
MUST NOT touch src/exchange/bitflyer/*, .github/workflows/*, or anything on the live order-submission path
